subject: Scheduling dedicated-pool sizing workshop & technical deep dive
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@cloudfin.com>, sre@cloudfin.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps after today's discovery — dedicated pool sizing & deep dive

Hi Elaine / CloudFin team,

Thanks again for the call today — really useful to hear about the latency-sensitive inference paths you're expecting (chat assist + real-time scoring). Per our discussion, the next best step is a focused sizing workshop that pairs our infra engineers with your SREs to lock throughput targets and a brief technical deep dive/demo for your architect team.

What I'd like to do next:
- Schedule a 60–75 minute sizing workshop (throughput profile, peak concurrency, worst-case latency targets).
- Pair that with a ~30 minute technical deep dive/demo for model behaviour and runtime knobs (batching, cache, quantization options).
- Share a short sizing template for you to pre-fill (helps us come prepared).

I've attached a lightweight sizing template and a draft mutual action plan (MAP) to align milestones. If you can confirm the rough expected qps per endpoint and an internal SLA number (p50 / p95 target), we can pre-seed recommendations before the call.

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue Aug 17, 09:30–11:00 or 13:00–14:15
- Wed Aug 18, 10:00–11:15 or 15:00–16:15

If none of these work, share a couple of windows and I’ll send a calendar invite. I can also post a Calendly link for final confirmation.

Attachments: cloudfin-sizing-template.xlsx (sheet with Qs), mutual-action-plan-draft.pdf

Thanks — look forward to locking a slot.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0184

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@cloudfin.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: sre@cloudfin.com
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps after today's discovery — dedicated pool sizing & deep dive

Sofia — thanks for the recap and for the materials.

We're interested in the dedicated pool path. A couple of clarifications before we lock a time:
1) For the sizing template, is it fine if we provide 1) expected peak qps per endpoint, 2) avg and p95 token length, and 3) concurrent users per region? That should be enough for you to pre-calc a baseline?
2) Our initial latency targets: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 400ms for the critical scoring endpoint. We'll confirm after an internal check but wanted to flag.
3) Can you share a rough expectation of GPU footprint for a 2k qps characterization so our infra team has a starting point? We don't need final numbers, just order-of-magnitude guidance to see if the dedicated route is viable cost-wise.

Availability: Tue Aug 17 13:00–14:00 works for our SRE lead; otherwise Wed Aug 18 15:00–16:00. If you can put a 75-minute slot on Tue 13:00 with an agenda that'd be great.

Quick ask: please add a Calendly or an invite so we can confirm. Also can you link the MAP back to a HubSpot record for our procurement contact?

Thanks — Elaine
Elaine Park
Head of Platform Engineering | CloudFin Solutions
elaine.park@cloudfin.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@cloudfin.com>, sre@cloudfin.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps after today's discovery — dedicated pool sizing & deep dive

Thanks Elaine — that's perfect and very helpful context. Short answers:
- The sizing template you outlined is exactly what we need (qps, token lengths, concurrency by route). We'll pre-run a few baseline configs once you return those fields.
- For an order-of-magnitude GPU footprint at ~2k qps (mixed routes, majority short responses ~40 tokens): rough ballpark is 6–10 A100-equivalent GPUs with continuous batching; we'll refine after we see your token distribution. This is intentionally conservative to account for peak bursts.

I've penciled in Tue Aug 17, 13:00–14:15 PDT for a 75-minute workshop + 15-minute follow-up buffer (agenda below). I'll send a calendar invite momentarily and pasted a Calendly link in case you prefer to book directly: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/60min

Proposed agenda (75 min):
- 0–10m: Introductions & objectives (SRE + infra goals)
- 10–35m: CloudFin production profile walkthrough (you) + key endpoints
- 35–55m: Redwood sizing recommendations & baseline config (runtime knobs)
- 55–70m: Deep dive: batching, cache behavior, quantization tradeoffs
- 70–75m: Action items and MAP alignment

Attached: cloudfin-sizing-template.xlsx (please fill the blue cells pre-call), mutual-action-plan-draft.pdf. I'll create a HubSpot deal record and link it here: https://hubspot.com/deal/CLOUDFIN-2027-0482

Calendar invite attached. If anything changes, ping me directly and we can shift.

Best,
Sofia

Attachments: cloudfin-sizing-template.xlsx, mutual-action-plan-draft.pdf

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Next steps after today's discovery — dedicated pool sizing & deep dive

Ben / Naomi — forwarding the CloudFin thread. They've confirmed Tue 8/17 13:00–14:15 PDT for the sizing workshop. Ask: can one of you join the call as the technical lead to present the runtime knobs (batching & KV caching) and run the baseline calculation live? If Ben is available that's great; otherwise Naomi can take it.

Notes for prep:
- I'll pre-seed the sizing template with the conservative 2k qps -> 6–10 A100-eq guidance and two fallback variants (lower-cost batched config and latency-optimized config).
- We should prepare a single slide with expected token-cost per call and expected tokens/sec per GPU under our baseline assumptions.

Let me know who can lead and any slides you'd like me to add to the deck.

Thanks — Sofia
